scope: Offline density audit of already recorded full-brain states; no neuronal simulation or source change

rivals.A: Many graded release/transmission coordinates remain active, so sparse spike counts alone do not justify skipping their coupling
rivals.B: Graded changes are small enough to motivate bounded approximate spatial integration, which still needs an influence/error bound
rivals.C: Changes are concentrated in a subset, supporting a measured structural partition before another global-integrator rewrite

decision: Describe occupancy and changes at zero plus five explicit thresholds. No threshold promotes an engine or proves quiescent neurons have no influence.
Jev_role: Route new bounded implementation/review tasks, never certify numerical or biological results
